svg.title: Forge — Settings
svg.text: Create mode, accessibility, audio, what is equipped right now, and your achievements.
One way to make something, a text box, and a few ideas to tap.
Turn it off to unlock every method, style, fit, pricing and sharing.
Turns off pulses, drifting embers and sweeps.
Darker panels, brighter text and borders.
Taps, forge chimes and reward stings.
